diagnosis: The SSR checkout route loads order details directly by orderId into a shared global Redux store without verifying that the order belongs to the authenticated customer (req.user.id). Furthermore, because the Redux store is instantiated once at the module level rather than per-request, concurrent client requests bleed shipping addresses, phone numbers, and payment details across customer sessions.
